title: Enterprise managed permissions for GitHub Copilot agent operations
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Enterprise administrators can centrally block, require approval for, or allow Copilot agent shell commands, file reads/edits, and network domains, with managed restrictions taking precedence over user settings and saved approvals.
actionable_takeaway: Build an agent operation policy matrix for shell, file, network, Keychain, and developer-tool access across app, CLI, VS Code, JetBrains, and Codex entry points.

title: Remediate Code Quality findings with agentic autofix
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Copilot can take up to 25 standard Code Quality findings, fix them agentically on a branch, validate changes, and open a PR, shifting backlog remediation into review queues.
actionable_takeaway: Treat bulk autofix as PR generation, not closure; require tests, diff scope, reviewer assignment, and AI credit tracking per batch.

title: Block pull requests with exposed secrets from merging
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Repository rulesets can now block PR merges until secret scanning completes and all PR-introduced secret alerts are resolved.
actionable_takeaway: Enable PR-layer secret merge gates for critical repositories and verify scan completed, open alerts, and bypass permission states with a test PR.

title: CodeQL 2.27.0 adds support for Linux ARM64
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: CodeQL CLI now runs natively on Linux ARM64, adds Rust command-line injection detection, and expands C#, Java/Kotlin, and private query-pack support.
actionable_takeaway: Add ARM64 runner parity checks for CodeQL version, query packs, private registry authentication, and language baseline diffs.

title: Enterprise-managed sandbox in Copilot for JetBrains
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Copilot for JetBrains now supports enterprise-managed sandbox controls for filesystem, network, proxy, developer tools, macOS Keychain, and policy diagnostics.
actionable_takeaway: Read back managed sandbox state inside JetBrains and compare it with CLI and VS Code policy behavior before trusting a shared agent profile.

title: OpenAI Agents Python 0.22.2 updates image tools and hardens UnixLocal files
author: OpenAI Agents SDK contributors
why_it_matters: The release supports current image generation tool options, prevents UnixLocal file API symlink races, and resets compaction response chains after pop.
actionable_takeaway: Add symlink-race and compaction-pop smoke tests before upgrading long-running local agent workflows.

title: OpenAI Node SDK 7.13.0 adds API key expiration controls
author: OpenAI / openai-sdks[bot]
why_it_matters: Node SDK support for API key expiration controls makes credential lifecycle governance available in the JavaScript production path.
actionable_takeaway: Extend service-account key receipts to record expiration controls and verify Node/Python parity before rotating production keys.

title: OpenAI Python SDK 3.11.0 adds service-account key expiration controls
author: OpenAI / openai-sdks[bot]
why_it_matters: Python automation can now use explicit expiration controls for service-account keys, matching the governance direction seen in other SDKs.
actionable_takeaway: Read back expiration fields in Python agent jobs and fail closed when key owner, expiry, or rotation fallback is missing.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.154.0 reaches stable release lane
author: OpenAI / GitHub Actions
why_it_matters: Codex moved from the previously observed alpha lane to a stable 0.154.0 release with platform assets, but public behavioral notes remain limited.
actionable_takeaway: Treat 0.154.0 as an upgrade candidate only after a fixed local smoke suite covers model picker, sandbox, file edits, and resume behavior.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.84-3 remains the latest visible CLI release
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: No newer public CLI release was observed beyond the MCP OAuth startup and copy-export fix captured yesterday, so that remains the current CLI validation target.
actionable_takeaway: Keep the cold-start OAuth MCP and /copy transcript smoke in the CLI upgrade gate until a newer release changes the target.
